audience: Software engineers with 1–5 years of experience preparing for coding interviews at large tech companies within the next 2–3 months
brief: Six weeks to interview-ready: learn the 16 patterns behind most LeetCode questions, then prove it in weekly mock interviews with engineers.

facts.text: 16 problem patterns covered through 180 hand-picked problems
Solutions and walkthroughs in Python, Java, C++ and JavaScript
4 live mock interviews with working engineers, with written feedback
73% of last cohort's 540 learners reported an onsite interview within 3 months
Full refund within 14 days if you have completed fewer than 20% of the lessons
